parameters.content:
# Telegram Voice and Text Support

## Configure before enabling
In **Support Configuration**, replace businessName, spreadsheetId, private humanChatId, private slackChannelId, supportContact and approvedFaq. The validator stops before API calls while placeholders remain. Only private customer chats are processed; bots and groups are ignored.

Assign **one Telegram bot** to the trigger and all Telegram actions. Add that bot to a private staff review chat and set that chat ID separately from customer IDs. Assign **Groq** to the HTTP nodes, **Google Sheets OAuth2** to Sheets, and **Slack OAuth2** to its private channel. No second customer bot is needed.

## Approved knowledge
Write reviewed facts and support procedures in approvedFaq. This template supplies no wallet brand, withdrawal limits, KYC timelines, slippage advice or financial policy. Model answers are suggestions grounded in that configured text, not verified account actions.

## Privacy defaults
storeMessageContent=false omits names, transcripts and reply content from Sheets. If changed, obtain approval and restrict spreadsheet access and retention. Staff notifications omit transcript content. Slack and Errors contain only case reference, stage, category, type and time. Successful and failed execution data saving is disabled; deployment logs may still need their own retention policy.

## 1. Validate input and check this chat's lock
The configuration and private Telegram message envelope are validated first. The Escalations read filters by chatId, and the Code node checks the same ID again. An open row pauses automated answers only between escalatedAt and lockExpiresAt, exactly 30 minutes apart. Expired or closed rows do not lock the chat. Malformed open rows cause review rather than an automatic answer.

Use a single row per chatId. Staff may set status=closed after resolving a case. There is no staff-to-customer reply bridge. A holding message does not mean anyone is actively working on the case. Sheets is not an atomic lock: serialize executions at deployment if simultaneous messages for a chat are possible.

## 2. Normalize message content
Voice: Telegram getFile downloads binary data, preserves it as data/voice.ogg, then Groq Whisper returns JSON text. Text is read directly. Both retain the same chat, customer, input type and case context.

Limits: private chats only; text and transcripts <=8000 characters; voice <=5 minutes and <=10 MB. Unsupported input gets a clear response. No personal account lookup or transaction execution is connected.

## 3. Classification is validated, not trusted blindly
Groq returns JSON with intent, sentiment, security_risk, needs_human and confidence. Enums, exact booleans, numeric range and finish_reason=stop are checked. Malformed, incomplete or unknown output goes to human review. It never defaults to a safe FAQ classification.

Human review also covers angry/frustrated messages, security, private-account requests, unsupported topics and confidence below configurable minimumConfidence (default 0.7). This threshold is a setup choice, not a measured accuracy guarantee.

Other messages use a fast FAQ answer, a contextual how-to answer, or detailed technical guidance. Every branch uses the same approvedFaq and must return structured reply/needs_human JSON. Missing knowledge or malformed reply output returns to human review.

parameters.content:
## 4. Save the lock, then notify staff
Upsert Escalations by chatId, without automatic write retries. The staff destination is configured independently from the customer chat and validated to differ. Staff receives a case reference, customer chat ID and reason, with no raw transcript. The customer acknowledgment is prepared only after Telegram confirms the staff message.

This workflow cannot promise a staff response time, provide medical or financial decisions, verify identity or forward staff replies. Configure supportContact as a real approved fallback. A staff notification failure leaves the lock in place and enters the operational error branch.

## 5. Deliver text or an optional spoken attachment
Telegram text and captions use HTML mode with all dynamic text escaped. Replies are limited to 3500 characters. No model-generated formatting is interpreted.

ttsEnabled=false by default. When enabled, incoming voice messages can receive English speech from canopylabs/orpheus-v1-english, voice troy. Groq returns WAV. WAV is sent as a **document attachment**, not as an OGG voice note or MP3 audio track. The caption contains the first 900 characters. If speech generation or attachment delivery fails, the same answer is sent as text and deliveryWarning records it.

Telegram sends and Sheets writes are not automatically retried. An uncertain text-send failure is logged and alerted without sending a second potential duplicate. Provider failures may still prevent delivery.

## Create three tabs with these exact row-1 headers

**Escalations**
chatId, caseId, escalatedAt, lockExpiresAt, status

**Interactions**
timestamp, caseId, chatId, inputType, userName, transcript, intent, sentiment, securityRisk, escalated, outcome, deliveryStatus, deliveryWarning, reply

**Errors**
timestamp, caseId, inputType, stage, errorCategory

Set chatId columns to plain text before use. Keep Escalations chatId unique. All writes explicitly use RAW mode so untrusted text is not parsed as a formula. Interactions is prepared from the correct pre-delivery context after Telegram succeeds, including escalations, holding replies and speech fallbacks. Log-write failure alerts staff without messaging the customer again.

## Operational failures
Read/transcription/classification/reply failures go to a sanitized error payload. Slack, Errors and a customer fallback are independent branches. No raw provider error, transcript, name or customer ID is sent to Slack or Errors. A log failure after delivery only alerts Slack. Failures in alerting, error logging or the final fallback stop without recursive retries.

Read-only Telegram file download and Sheets reads, plus stateless Groq transcription/chat generation, have at most two attempts with a 1-second delay and 120-second HTTP timeout. Groq generation can incur duplicate provider cost on retry. Speech generation, all sends and all writes have no automatic retries.

## Remaining setup and honest limits
Connect credentials, validate model access, configure the approved FAQ and real destinations, create the exact sheets, and choose privacy/retention settings. Serialize concurrent chat executions or replace Sheets with an atomic store if strict duplicate suppression is required. Replayed Telegram updates are not an exactly-once guarantee.
